text:
Diego M: Hey team, first week here. I hit a 403 on https://console.staging.redwood when I try to open Admin -> Feature Flags. Need to flip a demo flag for onboarding. Who can grant staging access?
DevEx Bot: Welcome Diego! File a short infra request and include your Okta email. For UI toggles request both "console-admin:staging" and "ff-operator". Docs: https://go/redwood-onboard/console-access
Diego M: Filed REQ-12021 (okta: diego.m@redwood.dev) and attached manager approval.
Infra Team: We can grant staging-only. Giving console-admin:staging + ff-operator to diego.m@redwood.dev for 72 hours. Avoid prod flags.
Diego M: I can see Admin -> Feature Flags now and toggled onboarding/demo-diego. Ran health: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.staging.redwood/health | jq .status` -> "ok". Thanks!
Priya S: Nice! Reminder: use demo/ prefix for ephemeral flags and request prod access only with security+manager sign-off. If you need a sandbox clone for demos, infra can provision one.
